state:
Goal `tools-agents`, the proofs of `docs/reference/tools/50-agents.md`. One of its three features is
done: `tools:agents/a-worked-session` has its example, its two cases, a Rust test that replays the
section's transcript against the binary, and three attacks. Two features are left, below.

Writing the attacks found two things. A call on a variable whose static type can never be a closure
compiled and died at run time; that is fixed, and is `E0420` now. A call on a `mixed` value that is
not a closure still ends the program with an internal error: gap
`nvs-runtime/a-call-on-a-value-that-is-not-a-closure-is-an-internal-error`, whose marker is on
`tests/hostile/tools/agents/a-worked-session/03-values-that-are-not-functions-are-called.nvs`.

The pack was missing `crates/nvs-cli/tests/agent.rs`, where every Rust proof of this chapter goes;
it is in `context.modules` now.

next.note: One slice is one feature with all its feature proofs (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`). One file set: `docs/reference/tools/50-agents.md`, `crates/nvs-cli/tests/agent.rs`, `crates/nvs-cli/src/agent.rs`.

items.text: **`tools:agents/nvs-agent`** — owes examples, hostile, tests. `docs/reference/tools/50-agents.md:10`. Its line `docs/reference/tools/50-agents.md:53` says a diagnostic names the spelling this language wants. `E0320`'s help is one sentence for every name, at `crates/nvs-hir/src/members.rs:1083`: `count($xs)` is told `Core\Str::length($s)`. The worked session's case pins it for `strlen`, where it is true. A proof of line 53 with another name fails, and `rule:testing/a-failing-proof-is-fixed-or-recorded` decides; the table of PHP names is `data/spec/php-migration.json`, and nothing in a crate reads it.

**`tools:agents/nvs-agent-init`** — owes examples, hostile, tests. `docs/reference/tools/50-agents.md:73`. The `init` tests and their `tree`, `init`, `files` and `read` helpers start at `crates/nvs-cli/tests/agent.rs:683`; none carries a `covers:` marker yet.

backlog: `nvs agent index` prints `Core\Bytes::join(array<bytes> $parts, bytes $separator = bytes())`, and `bytes()` is not an expression (`E0102`). Where the default is rendered is not checked; the member is in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/bytes.rs`.
`E0320`'s help names `docs/spec/02-php-migration.md`, a path somebody holding only the binary cannot open. Whether `nvs agent show` reaches that table is not checked.
Gap `nvs-runtime/a-call-on-a-value-that-is-not-a-closure-is-an-internal-error`: what a call deferred to run time throws is not decided by `rule:types/callable-is-a-closure`.
